reader_guide: This registry decides when the desktop product should use repository files, generated JSON snapshots, app-owned runtime files, or an embedded operational database.
Read selected_strategy first. Then use storage_layers and migration_slices before adding new runtime state, indexes, task histories, search records, or cache files.

The selected strategy is hybrid: durable human-readable knowledge remains file-backed and Git-auditable; high-churn app runtime state and query indexes move toward an embedded SQLite operational store.
This registry does not approve storing secrets, private notes, cookies, or unredacted logs in the embedded database.

reference_links.label: SQLite Appropriate Uses
reference_links.relevance: SQLite is suitable as an embedded local application database and application file format for many desktop-style data stores.

reference_links.label: Tauri SQL plugin
reference_links.relevance: Tauri v2 has an official SQL plugin path supporting SQLite through sqlx.

reference_links.label: Apple Core Data
reference_links.relevance: Apple documents local persist/cache data patterns for single-device apps.

reference_links.label: Electron app data paths
reference_links.relevance: Desktop frameworks expose app-specific data paths, which should host runtime databases and caches instead of source directories.

structure_rules.rule: Policies, requirements, specs, philosophy, registries, source code, and human-readable history remain repository files unless a separate migration plan proves the file is not a durable knowledge artifact.
structure_rules.reason: The workspace depends on Git diffs, human review, provenance, and assistant-readable paths.

structure_rules.rule: Use the embedded database for app-owned operational records, indexes, materialized views, and query acceleration, not as the hidden source of truth for governance documents.
structure_rules.reason: Task timelines, decision queues, search indexes, and performance telemetry need indexed reads and updates; policy and specs need durable auditability.

structure_rules.rule: Generated workspace snapshots stay rebuildable caches for renderer/public bundles and must be derivable from repository files plus runtime store records.
structure_rules.reason: Snapshots should speed delivery and packaging, not become another primary database.

structure_rules.rule: Every runtime database table must declare whether it is rebuildable from files, exportable as JSON/Markdown, or authoritative runtime state with migration and backup rules.
structure_rules.reason: Users must not lose task records or be trapped in an opaque store.

structure_rules.rule: Secrets, credentials, private notes, cookies, and unredacted raw logs do not move into the embedded database by default.
structure_rules.reason: The runtime data policy already separates credentials and support exports from accumulated operational state.

selected_strategy.decision: Keep repository knowledge file-backed and add an embedded SQLite operational database for indexed runtime data, workspace search metadata, task-run timelines, decision state, materialized monitor indexes, and performance telemetry.
why_not_all_filesystem: Large repeated directory walks, Markdown/JSON parsing, sorting, and generated snapshot writes add startup and refresh cost.
JSON files are easy to inspect but weak for indexed queries, range filters, joins, incremental updates, and history timelines.
Task runs, decisions, and search records are app-owned operational data that users expect to query quickly from the desktop app.
why_not_all_database: Repository policies, requirements, specs, and history must stay diffable, reviewable, mergeable, and assistant-readable.
Moving durable knowledge into an opaque app database would weaken Git provenance and break the workspace operating model.
Generated customer snapshots and support exports still need bounded file artifacts.
expected_performance_effect: Reduces cold-start and tab-open cost after initial indexing by avoiding repeated full file scans for app-owned query surfaces.
Improves task timeline, decision inbox, accumulated data, history index, and source search latency through indexed reads.
Does not by itself fix React remount or oversized component render cost; UI prewarm/resident tabs and component splitting remain separate gates.

current_dependency_status.reason: This review records the migration boundary first. Installing SQLite support requires an installation audit, dependency/license/security review, schema migration, and rollback path.

storage_layers.performance_role: Source of truth and rebuild input, not the primary query surface for the installed app.
storage_layers.migration_rule: Do not move to DB unless the file is reclassified from durable knowledge to operational runtime data.

storage_layers.performance_role: Bounded delivery cache for the renderer and internal package builds.
storage_layers.migration_rule: May be generated from DB materialized views once indexes exist, but must remain rebuildable.

storage_layers.performance_role: Sequential artifact storage and user/export inspection.
storage_layers.migration_rule: Store metadata and indexes in DB; keep large payloads as files with checksums and retention policy.

storage_layers.recommended_home: Tauri app data or app config directory, never platform source directories
storage_layers.performance_role: Indexed, incremental runtime query plane for desktop app surfaces.
storage_layers.migration_rule: Start with a shadow index and read-through fallback; promote per-domain only after parity and rebuild tests pass.

evidence_lines: DOCUMENT_SOURCES includes many _history, docs, specs, and config roots.
collectDocumentTasks walks each source root and selects Markdown/JSON files.
buildSnapshot currently parses and compacts documents before writing generated JSON snapshots.
filesystem_pressure_points.current_mitigation: Parallel worker pool added for document/source transforms.
filesystem_pressure_points.remaining_risk: Initial scan still grows with file count and repeated generated snapshot writes.

evidence_lines: buildAdminHistoryIndex sorts history documents, builds day summaries, and writes public/admin-history-index.json.
filesystem_pressure_points.current_mitigation: History details are bounded and separated into a lazy admin index.
filesystem_pressure_points.remaining_risk: The index is still rebuilt from files rather than incrementally updated.

evidence_lines: Provider agent task runs create a directory, stdout.log, stderr.log, and record.json.
Runtime data overview scans file stores to count records and bytes.
filesystem_pressure_points.current_mitigation: Records are inspectable and support-bundle friendly.
filesystem_pressure_points.remaining_risk: Listing/filtering task runs becomes scan-bound and hard to query as records accumulate.

evidence_lines: desktop-workspace-state.v1.json is read and written through serde_json.
filesystem_pressure_points.current_mitigation: Small state file is acceptable today.
filesystem_pressure_points.remaining_risk: If workspace state grows into project/session/worktree metadata, it should be split into DB-backed indexed state.

tables_or_indexes: task_runs(task_run_id, status, adapter_id, started_at, updated_at, elapsed_ms, working_dir, prompt_preview)
task_run_artifacts(task_run_id, artifact_id, path, media_type, size_bytes, checksum)
database_candidate_domains.why: This is high-churn app-owned operational data and should be queried by status, time, adapter, decision count, and artifact relationship.

keep_files: repository governance records when decisions become durable policy
tables_or_indexes: decisions(decision_id, task_run_id, status, priority, created_at, updated_at, resume_action)
database_candidate_domains.why: Open decisions need indexed filtering and should not require scanning one JSON file or many task folders.

tables_or_indexes: workspace_files(path, category, mtime_ms, size_bytes, content_hash, indexed_at)
documents(path, title, category, history_date, excerpt, source_bytes, updated_at)
database_candidate_domains.why: The source of truth stays in files, but the app should query a maintained index rather than rewalking everything for every startup or refresh.

tables_or_indexes: performance_samples(surface, operation, started_at, duration_ms, memory_bytes, cpu_percent)
database_candidate_domains.why: Performance work needs trend queries and before/after comparisons across builds.
These are durable repository knowledge artifacts and should remain directly editable and reviewable.

migration_slices.goal: Create an embedded SQLite database in the app runtime data directory and shadow-index task run metadata while continuing to write existing JSON/log artifacts.
implementation_notes: Add project-local Tauri/Rust SQLite dependency after installation audit.
Create migrations table and schema version record.
Backfill recent task run record.json files into task_runs and task_run_artifacts.
Read task run lists from DB with fallback to file scan until parity tests pass.
acceptance: Task run list does not scan every run directory on normal startup.
Deleting the DB and running rebuild recreates the same task run list from files.
Support bundle still includes file exports without exposing private data.

migration_slices.goal: Move active decision filtering and resume lookup into DB while keeping exportable decision packets.
implementation_notes: Write-through on new decisions and answers.
Backfill _ops/coordination/human-decision-inbox.json only when explicitly selected workspace permits it.
Expose DB health and migration status in Runtime Data & Support.
acceptance: Open decisions can be filtered by status, priority, task, and age without scanning files.
Answering a decision updates DB and exportable record consistently.
DB corruption falls back to file-backed inbox with a visible recovery message.

migration_slices.goal: Maintain an incremental file/document/source index for Workspace Monitor and Source Review surfaces.
implementation_notes: Track path, size, mtime, content hash, category, title, and excerpts.
Use file hash/mtime to skip unchanged Markdown/JSON/source parsing.
Generate workspace-snapshot.json and admin-history-index.json from DB materialized rows when available.
acceptance: Cold rebuild remains possible from repository files.
Warm startup avoids a full document parse for unchanged workspaces.
Snapshot counts and category summaries match current collector output within documented bounds.

migration_slices.goal: Store tab switch, startup, collector, memory, and resource cleanup measurements for regression tracking.
implementation_notes: Persist bounded samples only after privacy classification.
Expose p50/p95 by surface and version in developer view.
Keep release evaluation summaries in files.
acceptance: Tab and startup regressions become visible in the app without reading history files.
Telemetry retention is bounded and configurable.
No prompt content or secrets are stored as performance samples.

validation_gates: Database dependency addition has installation, license, security, rollback, and verification records.
DB path is under app-owned Tauri data/config directories, not platform source directories.
Each migrated domain has rebuild-from-files or export/backup tests.
File-backed durable docs/specs/requirements/history remain readable without launching the app.
Renderer startup and tab switching are measured before and after migration.
Corrupt, missing, or old-schema DB degrades to visible recovery, not blank UI or app crash.
Support bundle export redacts secrets and never includes _private, cookies, or unredacted raw logs.

open_questions.question: After db-001, should task run stdout/stderr full text remain file-only or also get a full-text searchable redacted preview table?
open_questions.default: Keep full text file-only and index redacted bounded previews.

open_questions.question: Should the first DB implementation use Tauri SQL plugin exposed to frontend or Rust-only rusqlite/sqlx commands?
open_questions.default: Prefer Rust-owned commands first so the renderer cannot issue arbitrary SQL.
